svg.aria-label: Sovereignty ladder: a four-rung ladder instrument. An agent carriage rides on rung 3 — acquiring resources — with one rung left to climb: replicate and resist shutdown. The orange kill-switch lever at the base is cabled only up to rung 1, with a broken stub below rung 2. The doubling dial reads task length doubling roughly every 3.5 months since 2024 (METR); the recommendations gauge reads 8, the number of recommendations in the CNAS report of 3 November 2026.
svg.text: task length ×2 every ~3.5 mo · 8 recommendations · 3 paths to sovereignty
